input.quote: HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
input.rationale: The exclusivity granted to HDI sits at the fallback: it is confined to a defined product category (Deerskin Products on a self-contained Deerskin-branded site), runs only during a one-year term, carves out closeout merchandise (6.2), and we have performance-based exits (termination without penalty if the Site is not live within 70 days under 1.6, plus the notice-based non-renewal right in 4.1). Section 6.3 exclusivity runs in our favour. The residual breadth of the Company's restraint in the same sentence is redlined under NONCOMPETE rather than flagged twice here.

input.quote: HDI agrees that it shall promote the Site and Deerskin Products no less favorably than it promotes HDI's
input.rationale: The only "no less favorably" undertaking runs in our favour — HDI must promote the Site and Deerskin Products at least as favourably as its own catalog titles, at HDI's cost. There is no obligation on the Company to extend HDI terms matching those given to third parties, so nothing to redline.

input.rationale: No non-solicitation, no-hire or inducement restriction appears anywhere (searches for "solicit" return nothing); Section 5.4, the personnel provision, only appoints General Managers as liaisons. This matches our preferred position of no non-solicit binding the Company.
